TC248.mechanism: Treatment reallocates a shared executor pool; user randomization does not make potential outcomes independent.
TC248.spatialBoundary: Infer connected pools from actual executor movements; administrative districts are not assumed independent.
TC248.temporalBoundary: Measure occupation carryover before choosing switchback blocks/washout with analyst.
TC248.falsification: If movement logs show no resource overlap or carryover, revise the interference hypothesis; do not treat it as proven.
TC248.estimand: Total pool completions with waiting guardrail, not relative group advantage.
TC248.numericModel: NOT_APPLICABLE; no invented sample size or block duration
